scope: Local calibration and subsequent matched HTTP/SQL serving qualification; no paid services. This is a control, not an originality claim.
metric: cosine of original finite, nonzero float32 vectors; no lossy input projection or quantization
payload: Each hit returns ID, score, 1024 ASCII bytes of deterministic revision-sensitive text and the full ordinal/bucket100/eligible10/eligible1/epoch metadata object. All engines ingest identical vectors, text and metadata.
durability: Each acknowledged write flushes its journal/WAL/translog and is visible to the next query. No replication. Ingest batches 500 rows; timed mutations are individual writes. Initial ingest atomicity across different engines is not claimed. Verify actual configuration and process-death recovery before timing.

calibration.data: Only calibration.f32; never open held-out test.f32 until the selected configuration receipt is sealed.
calibration.selection: For each build/filter, retain configurations passing all 1000 calibration queries in every declared state. Choose the lowest geometric mean of single-client medians across those states. Select the build minimizing the geometric mean across all filter/state medians. Ties use canonical JSON lexical order. Record every cell and failure; no held-out query used. Freeze separate choices per engine/corpus/hardware.

iterative.ivfflat: relaxed_order with final materialized-CTE distance sort

pgvector.metadataIndexes: B-tree on bucket100; partial indexes for eligible10 and eligible1

opensearch.filter: Inside knn field for efficient filtering; exact uses filtered knn_score script. Final response size remains 10 at both candidate counts.

qualification.queryOrder: Permutation sorted by SHA256(dataset/repetition/sourceOrdinal); same order in all engines, divided into contiguous equal client slices. Each query occurs once per cell.
qualification.cold: Clean process restart, page cache retained and explicitly disclosed; measure process start through first validated held-out response. Do not call it cold filesystem cache.
qualification.timingBoundary: One persistent connection per client process; pre-serialize request; time send through decoded payload. No retries. Validate payload after timer. Throughput is completed queries over global barrier-to-last-completion wall time, including validation/client scheduling overhead; record server and client CPU time.
qualification.latencyGate: Against fastest eligible comparator separately per cell: WARM median and p95 <=0.9 times comparator, p99 <=1.05 times comparator, every repetition. Do not pool failures.
qualification.advantageGate: Preselected >=2x completed-query throughput against fastest eligible comparator, maintained unfiltered state, 8 clients, both datasets, every repetition, both physical machines. No substitution of another metric after results.

resources.cpuBudget: 4 logical CPUs shared by server and clients; one engine at a time
resources.contamination: Retain host/guest load and memory evidence; unrelated sustained CPU load or memory pressure invalidates performance qualification, not a slower engine. Calibration timings are selection data, not qualified claims.

oracle: Independent float64 cosine full scan; resolve every exact membership discrepancy against scalar accumulation and boundary scores. Tolerance alone cannot waive membership. Keep all raw returned IDs, scores, errors, and payload validation hashes.
freeze: Hash this plan, driver and imported lifecycle source, dependency lock, actual executable artifacts, inputs and machine settings before calibration. Any correction keeps the old failed run and a new version receipt. Freeze selection before held-out searches.
revision: Before any corpus calibration: synthetic churn exposed insufficient OpenSearch candidate count at k=10; add k=32 and Lucene controls, and require calibration quality across all declared states. Prior plan remains in driver-v1..v4 archives. Cohort/objective/quality/durability gates unchanged.
